# Mary Longo Wedding Planner

> Mary Longo is a wedding planner, event planner and wedding celebrant based in Lecce (Salento, Puglia, Italy). She plans weddings, destination weddings for couples from abroad and private events across Lecce, Salento and the rest of Puglia, and officiates civil and symbolic ceremonies in Italian, English and French (Spanish, Russian and German with trusted partners).

Key facts:
- Business: Mary Longo Wedding Planner (also listed as "Love is Love – Mary Longo Wedding Planner"), Via Pistoia 8, 73100 Lecce, Italy. VAT IT03623540755.
- Experience: 25 years organising events, 10 years as a wedding planner and celebrant.
- Languages: Italian, English, French.
- Services: full wedding planning, partial planning, on-the-day coordination, destination weddings in Puglia, civil and symbolic ceremonies (sand, light, tie-the-knot rituals), private and corporate events.
- Prices: wedding planning services start from about €1,200; supplier costs are separate.
- Area: Lecce, Salento (Otranto, Gallipoli, Santa Maria di Leuca, Nardò, Galatina), Brindisi, Ostuni and all of Puglia; nearest airport Brindisi (BDS), about 40 km from Lecce.
- Real weddings: a Los Angeles couple married in a real Salento town square (with the mayor's permission, pizzica and local food stalls); a Lithuanian couple in a masseria; church weddings in Baroque Lecce; quarry and seaside receptions.
- Contact: +39 338 7441562 (also WhatsApp), info@marylongoweddingplanner.it, Monday–Friday 9:00–18:30, Saturday 9:00–13:30.

## Guides (English)
- [How much does a wedding in Puglia cost (and how much is a wedding planner)?](https://www.marylongoweddingplanner.it/en/guides/wedding-cost-puglia): The budget items of a wedding in Puglia and Salento, what drives costs up, how much a wedding planner in Lecce costs and how to stay on budget.
- [Getting married in Italy as a foreigner: documents, timing and types of ceremony](https://www.marylongoweddingplanner.it/en/guides/getting-married-in-italy-as-a-foreigner): Civil, religious or symbolic: which documents foreigners need to marry in Puglia (nulla osta, apostille, translations), the town hall steps and how a wedding planner helps.
- [Symbolic vs civil ceremony in Puglia: differences, venues and an English- or French-speaking celebrant](https://www.marylongoweddingplanner.it/en/guides/symbolic-ceremony-puglia): What a symbolic ceremony is, when a civil ceremony is legally binding, where they can take place in Puglia and how a multilingual celebrant in Lecce works.
- [The best time to get married in Puglia and Salento, month by month](https://www.marylongoweddingplanner.it/en/guides/best-time-to-get-married-in-puglia): Weather, light, prices and availability from April to October: when to get married in Puglia and Salento, according to a Lecce wedding planner.
- [Where to get married in Salento: masserie, Baroque Lecce, the sea, town squares and quarries](https://www.marylongoweddingplanner.it/en/guides/where-to-get-married-in-salento): The most beautiful wedding settings in Salento explained by a Lecce wedding planner: masserie, Baroque churches, the Ionian and Adriatic sea, town squares and quarries, with distances and tips.

## Guide (italiano)
- [Quanto costa sposarsi in Puglia (e quanto costa una wedding planner)](https://www.marylongoweddingplanner.it/guida/quanto-costa-sposarsi-in-puglia): Le voci del budget di un matrimonio in Puglia e nel Salento, cosa fa salire i costi, quanto costa una wedding planner a Lecce e come restare nel budget.
- [Sposarsi in Italia da stranieri: documenti, tempi e tipi di cerimonia](https://www.marylongoweddingplanner.it/guida/sposarsi-in-italia-da-stranieri): Rito civile, religioso o simbolico: quali documenti servono agli stranieri per sposarsi in Puglia (nulla osta, apostille, traduzioni), i passaggi in Comune e come vi aiuta una wedding planner.
- [Rito simbolico e rito civile in Puglia: differenze, luoghi e celebrante in inglese o francese](https://www.marylongoweddingplanner.it/guida/rito-simbolico-e-rito-civile-in-puglia): Cos'è il rito simbolico, quando ha valore legale il rito civile, dove si possono celebrare in Puglia e come lavora una celebrante multilingua a Lecce.
- [Il periodo migliore per sposarsi in Puglia e nel Salento, mese per mese](https://www.marylongoweddingplanner.it/guida/periodo-migliore-per-sposarsi-in-puglia): Meteo, luce, prezzi e disponibilità da aprile a ottobre: quando conviene sposarsi in Puglia e nel Salento secondo una wedding planner di Lecce.
- [Dove sposarsi nel Salento: masserie, Lecce barocca, mare, piazze e cave](https://www.marylongoweddingplanner.it/guida/dove-sposarsi-nel-salento): Le location più belle per un matrimonio nel Salento spiegate da una wedding planner di Lecce: masserie, chiese barocche, mare ionico e adriatico, piazze e cave, con distanze e consigli.
